review_scope: Bounded independent review of vector comparison oracle, measurement and error accounting; coordinator inspected the identified implementations.
status: unresolved; benchmark freeze and execution blocked

findings.finding: Timed ANN outputs do not receive per-repetition recall and relevance gates. Static/lifecycle success can permit a performance claim even when timed graph queries have zero oracle recall.
findings.acceptance: Gate each repetition's actual timed outputs against matching exact references and the oracle; a synthetic zero-recall timed graph case must reject qualification.

findings.finding: Static and lifecycle row counts do not establish complete unique query identities. Duplicate q0 rows can hide missing q1 while the expected row count is satisfied.
findings.acceptance: Validate exact expected query identities, uniqueness and completeness in both result and reference sets; regress duplicate, missing and unexpected IDs.

findings.finding: The fullGraph route checks returned cosine scores and membership but does not validate descending score order; reversed correct-score results can pass.
findings.acceptance: Validate descending canonical scores regardless of retrieval route; regress reversed graph results while preserving the declared numerical tolerance.

evidence_limit: Reviewer used synthetic accounting cases only. No real comparison corpus queries or measurements have run. These are harness qualification defects, not demonstrated WARM retrieval defects.
